card.title: 980. VOLKSGRENADIER
card.flavorText: The 980th Volksgrenadier Regiment fought under the 272nd Volksgrenadier Division and participated in numerous battles on the Western Front until it was largely encircled in what is known as the Battle for the Ruhr Pocket in April 1945. Volksgrenadier was a name given to German Army divisions that were formed in the autumn of 1944 after a series of military defeats against the Allies. These divisions participated in the final stages of the war, including the Battle of the Bulge, the defense of the Eastern Front and Siegfried Line, and in the final battles in Germany.
